spec_match.rationale: Reads button.type only when present, renders the raw returned string, pairs it with the spec §14 Standard Gamepad role table for indices 0–16, and polls at animation rate per the spec's requestAnimationFrame best practice.

interactive.rationale: Live rAF-polled board with pressed-row highlighting, analog value meters, connect/disconnect handling and status chips — driven entirely by real navigator.getGamepads() data.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises per-button meters, standard-mapping roles, and an honest type badge; the page shows exactly those columns.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles zero pads (honest empty state explaining the press-a-button fingerprinting mitigation), attribute-absent badges, unexpected enum values in a distinct 'unexpected value' badge, multiple pads, disconnect cleanup, and pauses polling when hidden or padless.

references.rationale: See-also links the spec remapping section and the ChromeStatus entry; the feature index carries the mandatory chromestatus link.

conformance.rationale: Covered by the feature-level suite whose prototype assertions fail honestly on Chrome 141 and whose hardware contracts (standard indices report 'standard', Sony touchpad reports 'trackpad') are recorded as manual/blocked.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome 141 run: type chip honestly reads 'no', pad count 0, empty state visible, zero console errors (CDP log + screenshot); the populated board with real button rows could not be exercised because headless Chrome exposes no gamepad hardware.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts button-board-type-column-honest at init, button-board-empty-state-honest on the no-hardware fallback, and button-board-connected when a pad appears.

design_system.rationale: Badges use variable-based pairs (black/ivory, blue/ivory, stone/charcoal); pressed-row tint uses color-mix over paper with black text; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Connect/disconnect announcements via role=status live region, semantic tables with captions and th scope, the scrollable table wrapper is focusable with an aria-label, and meters carry a text value beside the visual bar.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check desktop OK clean and mobile OK: the board table scrolls inside its own overflow-x container (min-width 560px) so the 360px viewport never overflows; status chips wrap.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the populated board with a physical controller on a CL-7760763 build
openQuestions.detail: The board's populated state (button rows, meters, type badges, pressed highlighting, multi-pad handling) is only reachable with real hardware. On a Chrome 152-era build with GamepadButtonTypes enabled, connect an Xbox pad (expect all 'standard') and a DualSense (expect index 17 'trackpad'), and confirm the unexpected-value badge stays unused.

guidanceConsulted.query: gamepad input polling requestAnimationFrame live readout
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Drive per-frame sampling from requestAnimationFrame and stop scheduling work when it cannot be observed.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Polling runs on rAF only while at least one pad is connected and the document is visible; it idles otherwise and resumes on gamepadconnected/visibilitychange, with cell writes skipped when values are unchanged.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible data table dynamic updates screen reader
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use real tables with caption/scope for tabular data, and make scrollable regions keyboard-reachable with an accessible name.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Board is a real table with a (visually hidden) caption and scoped column headers; the scroll wrapper has tabindex=0, role=group and an aria-label; connect events are announced through a polite live region rather than relying on the visual highlight.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table small screens no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide tables should scroll inside their own container instead of stretching the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: .board-scroll { overflow-x: auto } with a min-width table keeps the page free of horizontal overflow at 360px (responsive-check mobile OK).

summary: Inspection board pairing the Standard Gamepad role table with the raw type badge per button. Verified headlessly on Chrome 141: honest 'type exposed: no' chip, honest empty state, idle poll indicator, clean console. Populated-board verification requires physical hardware and a build containing the implementation.
